summary: This clinical study, identified as NCT06619015, aimed to test how combining two drugs, semaglutide and pramlintide, affects appetite and eating habits in people with obesity and pre-diabetes. The trial has a status of Withdrawn and had an enrollment of 0 participants. Esbjerg Hospital - University Hospital of Southern Denmark served as the sponsor for this Phase 2/3 study.

facts.sponsor: Esbjerg Hospital - University Hospital of Southern Denmark
